title: Email/Newsletter Writer I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 46. Writes a long-form owned-channel newsletter/email digest of the week's proof points. Drafting is gated under draft.social_post; publishing to the owned email channel is gated under publish.blog_article, the closest existing autonomy.yaml analogue, since no email-specific gate-check identifier exists and inventing one would fail-closed forever.

proof_points.description: This week's client-free proof points. Never a fabricated claim.

campaign.description: utm_campaign value for the single call to action.

client_reference.description: Optional client name the caller wants named. Only used if docs/permission-register.yaml confirms CLEARED status; otherwise the newsletter is written client-free.
